question: What further effect follows from the vivid arising of many consciousnesses?
premises: The clear flashing of many consciousnesses can turn disrepute into repute.
This transformation can yield abundant fruit.
The result is compared to a seed watered by a river in the sky.
inference: When many vivid consciousnesses arise, even adverse outcomes can be transformed into abundantly fruitful ones.
uncertainties: The long compound in token 2 is transmitted as a single fused form; internal segmentation is interpretive.
plain_english: Moreover, through the clear flashing forth of many consciousnesses, even disrepute can become repute, bearing abundant fruit like a seed watered by the waters of a river in the sky.
